observations: Photo 0 shows a beige 2-seater couch with rounded armrests and a low backrest, placed against a yellow wall on a tiled floor.
Photo 1 is a closer view of the same couch, showing the front and side profile. The fabric appears to be a light-colored, possibly off-white or cream, material with visible creases and minor stains.
The couch has a simple, modern design with no visible buttons or controls on the backrest.
No brand or model is visible on the couch in either photo.
The seller claims it is 'very neat' and 'bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm'.

claims.claim: Very neat 2 seater couch for sale
claims.evidence: Photos show minor creases and stains, but 'very neat' is subjective and not fully supported by visual evidence.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Hidden stains or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up shot of the fabric under direct light, especially on the backrest and seat cushions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having minor stains or wear, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Material is not high-quality (e.g., low-grade vinyl or synthetic)
risks.proof: Close-up of the fabric texture and stitching quality, or a shot of the underside of the couch.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic fabric couch, not premium material.

risks.risk: Couch is not in working condition (e.g., broken springs, loose cushions)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the couch being pressed and released, or a close-up of the foam and springs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the fabric under direct light to check for stains or damage.
Video or photo showing the couch being pressed and released to test foam and springs.
Close-up of the stitching and material texture.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
